title: Group Room Blocks Interim Deposit Amount
content:
The interim deposit of a Group Room Blocks contract is the interim percentage applied to the anticipated room revenue, and the anticipated room revenue is the contracted room nights times the group rate. The interim percentage is the block type's interim deposit percentage, and the interim deposit is rounded to the cent once, on the final amount, and is never below zero.

### Terms of the worksheet

| Term | Read from |
|---|---|
| Contracted room nights | the block record, as it stands when the amount is worked out |
| Group rate | the block record |
| Anticipated room revenue | contracted room nights times the group rate, not rounded on its own |
| Interim percentage | the block type's interim deposit percentage |
| Interim deposit | the interim percentage of the anticipated room revenue, rounded to the cent once at the end, never below zero |

### Worked figure (hypothetical block; the interim percentage is assumed at 25 percent for the illustration)

1. Contracted room nights 137, group rate 189.45 USD.
2. Anticipated room revenue: 137 times 189.45 is 25,954.65 USD.
3. 25 percent of 25,954.65 is 6,488.6625 USD.
4. Rounded to the cent once: 6,488.66 USD.

### Rounding point

The cent rounding is applied a single time, to the final amount in step 4; the anticipated room revenue in step 2 is carried at full precision into step 3.
